explanation: The pillow was concealing a severed human hand. The young woman had cut it from another person and put it in the pillow to carry it through baggage security. When the personnel inspected the luggage, they found the hand and arrested her. The other things she listed were ordinary travel items; the hand was the human remain she was transporting.

The item she called a pillow was a disguise for a severed human hand. She had cut the hand off another person and packed it among her overnight belongings to take it through security. Inspection exposed the human bones and the hand, so security handcuffed her for carrying evidence of a violent crime.
